metadata.steps_definition: One env.step per shot, including every correction and restoration; one reset reading per branch is excluded. No threading replay.
metadata.score_definition: Last actual single-shot SimEnv benchmark_score, including mismatch, loss and shot-count penalty; lower is better.
metadata.time_definition: Local simulation/model/optimizer compute wall time; no real-machine setting, settling, trigger or camera acquisition latency.

notes: Single-shot, stochastic final readings; fixed-budget reference used three-shot final averages.
All same 100 episode seeds and the fixed centered 1 mm target; no discovery or replay acquisition overhead.
Completed means beam at the IP; strict final target_met additionally requires each size within 15%, each centroid within 0.1 target sigma, and on-screen fraction >=90%.
Focus stopping emulates MBRL aggregate mismatch<=0.15 or patience=3; BO also uses MF-BO expected improvement versus marginal benchmark shot cost.
Wall times are simulator/model/optimizer compute durations, not real accelerator operating times.
